issue_body:
The parsing logic for the backward-compatible (pre-0.29.0) list of positional arguments uses index 2 twice:

https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/c8a46925366361e40b65b117473db1342895b904/starlette/templating.py#L168-L173

`headers`, `media_type` and `background` should be at indices 3, 4 and 5, respectively.
problem_statement:
Index Errors in old-style Jinja2Templates.TemplateResponse
The parsing logic for the backward-compatible (pre-0.29.0) list of positional arguments uses index 2 twice:

https://github.com/encode/starlette/blob/c8a46925366361e40b65b117473db1342895b904/starlette/templating.py#L168-L173

`headers`, `media_type` and `background` should be at indices 3, 4 and 5, respectively.
note: problem_statement is the exact participant-facing task text (方案.txt section 11.1, Low/Cold Context).
